## Problem and scope

Describe the user-visible problem and intended behavior/boundary.

## Evidence

- [ ] Failing deterministic reproduction added before implementation where applicable.
- [ ] `bash ./init.sh` passes before/after; no sensor/assertion weakened or skipped.
- [ ] Docs and affected formal models/companions updated; handoff appended.
- [ ] Acceptance history preserved; no self-approved feature pass flags.

List commands/results, platforms tested, and checks not run (including deep proof).
Do not attach raw settings/session archives. Follow SECURITY.md for vulnerabilities.
